title: PNG vs JPG Explained for Better Image Decisions
description: Compare PNG and JPG so you can choose the best format for web use, sharing, and image quality needs.
author: Converigo
og_image_alt: Comparison chart for PNG and JPG

sections.title: When PNG is the better choice
sections.content: PNG is often preferred for graphics that need transparency, crisp edges, or a lossless appearance. It is a good option for logos, screenshots, and design work that needs detail preservation.

sections.title: When JPG is the better choice
sections.content: JPG is widely used for photos because it offers smaller file sizes and broad compatibility. It is practical when you need to share images quickly or save storage space.

sections.title: Which format should you pick?
sections.content: If you need transparency or exact editing quality, PNG is usually the safer bet. If you want smaller files for everyday photography, JPG is often more convenient.

faq.question: Is PNG always better than JPG?
faq.answer: No. PNG is better for some use cases, but JPG is often the more efficient option for photographs and general sharing.

faq.question: Can I convert PNG to JPG without losing quality?
faq.answer: You can convert between them, but the result may change because JPG uses compression and PNG preserves more detail.

faq.question: Which format is better for web use?
faq.answer: It depends. JPG is often better for photos, while PNG is often better for graphics with transparency.
